crossRefs.note: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’
Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’ ”
Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

parallels.note: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’ ”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’ ”
translations.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
translations.asv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
